evals.name: Basic Gross-to-Net Reconciliation with Clean Data
evals.description: Tests basic GL reconciliation with clean payroll and GL data. No major discrepancies. Should achieve 100% match rate.
evals.scenario: Monthly payroll processing with standard GL timing. All wage types reconcile cleanly to GL accounts. Net pay matches liability account.

expected_outcomes.description: Should show reasonable match rate. Unmatched items expected due to intentional test discrepancies (timing, retro, missing). Gross-to-net walkdown should identify variance drivers.

evals.name: Complex Reconciliation with Timing Differences and Retro Adjustments
evals.description: Tests reconciliation with timing mismatches between payroll and GL, plus retroactive adjustments. Should identify reconciling items correctly.
evals.scenario: Payroll processed 1/31 but GL posted 2/1. Includes retroactive bonus adjustment split across clearing account. Tests identification of timing differences and retro adjustments.

expected_outcomes.description: Should identify timing differences and rounding in reconciling items. Unmatched items from retro and missing GL are expected. Multi-type reconciliation should complete.

evals.name: Cost Center-Level Reconciliation with Unmatched Items
evals.description: Tests cost center allocation reconciliation. Includes intentional unmatched item (missing GL posting). Should identify and report unmatched items.
evals.scenario: Validates payroll allocation by cost center against GL postings. One wage type/cost center combination missing GL posting. Tests unmatched item identification and variance analysis by cost center.
evals.command: python ../scripts/reconcile_payroll_gl.py files/payroll_results.xlsx files/gl_postings.xlsx --recon-type cost_center_allocation --tolerance 0.01 --output eval_003_results.json && python ../scripts/generate_recon_report.py eval_003_results.json --output eval_003_report.xlsx

expected_outcomes.description: Should identify missing GL posting for wage type 1010, cost center 1000. Cost center allocation should show variance. Report should clearly show unmatched items.

generated_files.description: Payroll results with 50 employees, wage types (income, deductions, taxes, employer costs), cost center assignment
GL account level postings derived from payroll with intentional discrepancies

intentional_discrepancies.description: Payroll processed 1/31, GL posted 2/1 (standard SAP payroll-to-GL posting timing)
3 x $0.01 rounding variances from employee-level vs GL-level aggregation
Wage type 1030 (Bonus) split 50/50: 50% normal posting, 50% through clearing account 9100
Wage type 1010 (Overtime), Cost Center 1000 not posted to GL (will show as unmatched)

validation_steps: Verify SKILL.md is valid Markdown with proper frontmatter
Verify reconcile_payroll_gl.py handles flexible column matching
Verify references are comprehensive and well-formatted
Run all three eval cases and verify expected outcomes
Verify CLI argument handling matches specification
